extension.description:
Lets Kodi correct the letters an OCR keeps misreading in German subtitles made from disc images ("l" for "I", "rn" for "m", a dropped accent). Only a mistake a subtitle repeats is corrected, and only into a word of the language.
Holds LibreOffice's German Hunspell dictionary and the few facts about the language the repair needs. Needs the allolive build of CoreELEC, where System > Yacer > Subtitles > Correct misread letters installs and removes it.
